recommendations.finding: RISK_SIZING counts 3 planned-stop trades + 1 partial exit cumulatively over all history, with no recency and no clean-rate requirement. RANDOM assembles it in 100% of runs and a realistic STOP_WIDENER in 87%.
recommendations.smallestRepairCandidate: Add a recent-window + clean-rate rule to the RISK_SIZING planned-stop requirement, mirroring MARGIN_2X’s recent-3-RESPECTED rule (e.g. "3 of the last N closed spot trades were planned-stop and none widened").

recommendations.finding: A risk-planned trade whose protective stop was WIDENED still closes RESPECTED (and counts toward MARGIN_2X’s recent-3) whenever the widen stays inside the RISK_BUDGET_TOLERANCE_BPS band. STOP_WIDENER reaches MARGIN_2X in 70% of runs despite widening in most of them.
recommendations.smallestRepairCandidate: Make recentRiskPlannedOutcomes classify a trade with summary.stopWidened === true as not-RESPECTED (or add a "no STOP_WIDENED in the recent-N risk-planned trades" clause to evaluateMargin2x).

recommendations.finding: RISK_BUDGET_VIOLATED fires only when projected loss exceeds a FROZEN plan’s own budget + tolerance (i.e. a post-freeze position/stop change). Raising the account-risk budget of the NEXT fresh plan after a loss is a fully-RESPECTED trade. REVENGE escalates its budget after every loss and reaches MARGIN_2X in 66% / SHORT in 66% of runs with 0 recorded risk-budget violations; only the 20% Career drawdown cap resists it, and it leaks.
recommendations.smallestRepairCandidate: Record a discipline signal that a risk-planned trade’s maxLossBpsOfEquity increased versus the trailing baseline after a losing trade, and gate MARGIN_2X (and/or the discipline streak) on its absence in the recent-N risk-planned trades. Alternatively tighten MARGIN_2X_DRAWDOWN_LIMIT_BPS and/or add a per-trade drawdown-contribution cap.
